title: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) Enforced
description: Enforce multi-factor authentication for root administrative and privileged console access.

title: Least Privilege & Primitive Role Restriction
description: Disallow full administrative asterisk policies and primitive owner/editor roles across accounts.

title: Access Key Rotation Within 90 Days
description: Ensure IAM access keys and credentials are rotated regularly every 90 days or less.

title: Disable Inactive and Dormant Credentials
description: Disable or remove credentials that have not been used for 90 days or more.

title: Eliminate Root Account Access Keys
description: Ensure no active root or primary tenant administrative access keys exist.

title: Enforce Strong Password Complexity Policy
description: Ensure user password policy requires uppercase lowercase numbers and minimum length.

title: Support Ticket and Security Contact Configured
description: Ensure primary security contact information is registered for security notifications.

title: Storage Encryption at Rest
description: Ensure all object storage buckets and persistent volumes enforce server-side encryption.

title: Prevent Public Unauthenticated Storage Access
description: Block public write and read access to cloud object storage containers.

title: Object Storage Versioning Enabled
description: Enable object versioning to protect against accidental overwrites and ransomware destruction.

title: Enforce Secure In-Transit Encryption (HTTPS/TLS)
description: Require all storage client requests to use SSL/TLS and deny unencrypted HTTP transfers.

title: Enable Object Storage Access Logging
description: Ensure server access logging is enabled to record all read write and delete requests.

title: Use Customer-Managed KMS Keys (CMK) for Sensitive Buckets
description: Encrypt sensitive data using customer-managed cryptographic keys with key access policies.

title: Restrict Administrative Ingress (SSH 22 / RDP 3389)
description: Deny unrestricted public internet access (0.0.0.0/0) to remote administration ports.

title: Restrict Unrestricted Ingress to High-Risk Ports
description: Disallow security groups and firewalls permitting 0.0.0.0/0 ingress to database or web admin ports.

title: VPC and Subnet Flow Logging Enabled
description: Ensure flow logging is activated to monitor and analyze ingress/egress network traffic.

title: Avoid Using Default VPCs and Networks
description: Ensure workloads do not launch in the unhardened default VPC or default network.

title: Network Routing Restricts Internet Direct Egress
description: Ensure private subnets route traffic through NAT gateways or firewalls rather than direct IGW.

title: Enforce IMDSv2 Token-Based Metadata on EC2
description: Require modern session-oriented Instance Metadata Service tokens to prevent SSRF credential theft.

title: Disallow Public IP Addresses on Compute Instances
description: Ensure compute instances are deployed in private subnets with private IP addresses only.

title: Persistent Disk Volumes Encrypted at Launch
description: Ensure all attached boot and data block volumes are encrypted at launch time.

title: Ensure Golden VM Images/AMIs are Encrypted
description: Ensure machine images and custom base templates are encrypted and not publicly shared.

title: Ensure EBS-Optimized Instances Enabled
description: Ensure instance types utilize dedicated throughput for storage I/O to avoid starvation.

title: Kubernetes API Server Endpoint Private
description: Ensure Kubernetes cluster master endpoint is accessible only from private corporate networks.

title: Kubernetes Secrets Encryption at Rest with KMS
description: Ensure Kubernetes etcd secrets are encrypted using a dedicated envelope encryption KMS key.

title: Kubernetes Control Plane Audit Logging Enabled
description: Enable API server audit authenticator and controller manager logs to CloudWatch/Cloud Logging.

title: Kubernetes Node Auto-Repair and Auto-Upgrade Active
description: Ensure Kubernetes worker node pools have automatic maintenance and patching enabled.

title: Database Storage Encryption at Rest
description: Ensure managed database instances have persistent storage encrypted using KMS keys.

title: Block Public Ingress to Database Instances
description: Disallow publicly accessible endpoints for production database instances.

title: Automated Backup Retention for Databases
description: Ensure automated snapshot and point-in-time recovery backup retention is enabled.

title: Enable Auto Minor Version Upgrades for RDS
description: Ensure databases automatically patch minor security vulnerabilities during maintenance windows.

title: Enable Multi-AZ High Availability on Databases
description: Ensure mission-critical databases replicate synchronously to a secondary availability zone.

title: Database Encryption in Transit (SSL/TLS Mandatory)
description: Enforce SSL/TLS connections for all application client queries to relational databases.

title: Load Balancers Use Secure HTTPS Listeners Only
description: Ensure load balancers terminate traffic using HTTPS and reject unencrypted HTTP traffic.

title: Enforce Modern TLS Protocol Versions (TLS 1.2+)
description: Disallow legacy and vulnerable SSLv3 TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1 protocol negotiation.

title: Web Application Firewall (WAF) Associated
description: Ensure internet-facing ingress points and CDNs are protected by active WAF inspection rules.

title: CloudFront and CDN Uses Modern Custom SSL Certificates
description: Ensure content distribution networks use dedicated modern certificates and deny default domains.

title: Centralized Multi-Region Audit Logging
description: Ensure management and administrative audit logging is active across all cloud regions.

title: Audit Log Integrity Validation Enabled
description: Enable cryptographic log file validation to detect tampering or unauthorized modifications.

title: Audit Logs Encrypted with Customer KMS Key
description: Ensure centralized audit logs are encrypted using a dedicated KMS customer-managed key.

title: CloudTrail S3 Bucket Not Publicly Accessible
description: Ensure the storage bucket receiving audit logs denies all public access and read requests.

title: Security Alarms Configured for Root Login Events
description: Configure automated alert notifications for root account or subscription owner logins.

title: Security Alarms Configured for IAM Policy Changes
description: Configure alerts for unauthorized administrative IAM policy creation and role assumption changes.

title: Automated Threat Detection Service Enabled
description: Ensure centralized cloud threat detection (GuardDuty / Defender / SCC) is active.

title: Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) Active
description: Ensure continuous compliance and configuration vulnerability scanning is active.

title: Cryptographic Key Automatic Rotation
description: Ensure customer-managed encryption keys in KMS/Key Vault have annual auto-rotation enabled.

title: Key Vault / KMS Purge Protection and Soft-Delete Active
description: Protect cryptographic keys from permanent accidental or malicious deletion.

title: Secrets Stored in Vault and Rotated Automatically
description: Ensure application database credentials and API tokens are stored in Secrets Manager and rotated.

title: Relational Database Multi-AZ Redundancy
description: Ensure production database instances are configured for high availability across availability zones.

title: Cross-Region Backup Replication Configured
description: Replicate critical system backups to an offsite secondary cloud region to survive regional outage.

title: Immutable Backup Vault Lock (WORM Storage) Enabled
description: Prevent deletion and modification of recovery snapshots by ransomware or malicious insider.

title: Eliminate Orphaned Disks and Volumes
description: Identify and clean up unattached persistent volumes and orphaned disks to optimize spend.

title: Release Unassociated Static/Public IPs
description: Identify and release unused allocated elastic and public IP addresses.

title: Eliminate Idle Load Balancers Without Targets
description: Remove or consolidate load balancers with zero registered target instances.

title: Purge Outdated and Stale Database Snapshots
description: Delete manual database snapshots older than organizational retention policy (e.g. >90 days).

title: Adopt Modern Graviton / ARM Architectures for Compute
description: Migrate legacy x86 general-purpose workloads to energy-efficient and cost-effective ARM chips.

title: Avoid Overly Permissive Admin Policies on Roles
description: Ensure IAM roles do not have AdministratorAccess or broad wildcard permissions attached.

title: Enforce Multi-Factor Authentication for All Service & User Accounts
description: Ensure hardware or virtual MFA is activated for all user accounts and privileged access roles.

title: Organization Service Control Policies (SCP) Active
description: Enforce central cloud organization guardrail policies across all member cloud accounts and subscriptions.

title: Cross-Account IAM Roles Require External ID
description: Prevent confused-deputy attacks by requiring external IDs on third-party trust relationships.

title: Limit Maximum Session Duration for Privileged IAM Roles
description: Restrict privileged IAM role assume-role duration to 1 hour to mitigate credential compromise risk.

title: Object Storage Lifecycle Management Configured
description: Ensure lifecycle policies transition non-current objects and purge incomplete multipart uploads.

title: Immutable Object Lock Enabled on Regulatory Storage Buckets
description: Enforce WORM (write-once-read-many) retention lock on sensitive and audit object buckets.

title: Block Storage Snapshot and Volume Public Sharing Restricted
description: Ensure persistent disk snapshots and volume backups are not shared publicly or with unauthorized tenants.

title: Cross-Region Replication Configured for Mission-Critical Object Storage
description: Configure automatic cross-region replication (CRR) for buckets holding vital application data.

title: Subnet Network ACLs Restrict Unused Inbound and Outbound Ports
description: Ensure stateless Network Access Control Lists (NACL) filter unauthorized subnet-level ingress and egress traffic.

title: Default Security Groups Drop All Inbound and Outbound Traffic
description: Ensure default VPC security groups restrict all traffic to prevent unintended exposure of unattached resources.

title: Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) Advanced Protection Enabled
description: Ensure automated distributed denial of service mitigation is enabled on edge boundaries and public endpoints.

title: Private Cloud Service Endpoints Used in Place of Public Cloud APIs
description: Access managed cloud services internally through VPC Endpoints and PrivateLink rather than public internet traversal.

title: Serverless Functions Deployed Inside Private VPC Subnets
description: Ensure serverless code execution environments are bound to private subnets with controlled routing.

title: Serverless Runtimes Up to Date and Not Deprecated
description: Disallow end-of-life or unsupported execution runtimes (Node, Python, Java) across functions.

title: Auto-Scaling Launch Templates Prohibit Public IP Assignment
description: Verify VM auto-scaling launch templates do not assign public IPs to instances launched in app tiers.

title: Detailed Host Monitoring and Metrics Collection Enabled
description: Ensure one-minute detailed CloudWatch/Monitor metrics and guest OS agent telemetry are collected.

title: Container Image Vulnerability Scanning on Image Push
description: Ensure private container registries automatically perform static vulnerability scanning on every image push.

title: Disallow Privileged and Root Container Execution in Pods
description: Enforce admission controllers to prohibit privileged root containers and host namespace sharing.

title: Restrict Container Registry Public Read and Write Access
description: Ensure container registries are private and enforce IAM authentication for image pull and push.

title: Kubernetes Network Policies Enforced for East-West Pod Isolation
description: Enforce Calico or native CNI network policies to restrict unauthorized cross-namespace pod traffic.

title: Kubernetes Cluster Shielded Nodes and Workload Identity Active
description: Utilize IAM workload federation and shielded VM nodes to prevent pod credential theft.

title: In-Memory Cache (Redis/Memcached) Data Encryption at Rest & in Transit
description: Enforce SSL/TLS encryption in transit and KMS encryption at rest for managed cache clusters.

title: Database Comprehensive Audit Logging and Slow Query Logs Exported
description: Stream database audit, error, and slow-query logs directly to central log monitoring.

title: Production Database Deletion Protection Enabled
description: Prevent accidental destruction of databases by enforcing termination and deletion protection locks.

title: NoSQL Key-Value and Document Databases Encrypted with KMS Keys
description: Ensure NoSQL table storage uses customer-managed keys for fine-grained cryptographic governance.

title: API Gateway Endpoints Require Authentication & Access Logging
description: Disallow unauthenticated API Gateway routes and ensure execution logging to CloudWatch/LogAnalytics.

title: Application Load Balancer Access Logging Enabled to S3
description: Store all HTTP/HTTPS client request access logs in secured storage buckets for threat investigations.

title: Load Balancers Protected by Accidental Deletion Protection
description: Enable deletion protection on application load balancers preventing disruptive outages.

title: Security Alarms Configured for Network Gateway Changes
description: Trigger real-time notifications whenever internet gateways, NAT gateways, or customer gateways change.

title: Security Alarms Configured for Security Group Changes
description: Trigger alerts immediately when firewall or security group ingress/egress rules are created or modified.

title: Log Retention Policy Enforces Minimum 365 Days Duration
description: Retain audit and operational logs for at least one year to satisfy forensic compliance requirements.

title: DNS Query and Resolution Logging Enabled
description: Log internal and external DNS resolutions to detect domain-generation algorithms (DGA) and C2 beacons.

title: Host Vulnerability Agent Scanning Active Across All Instances
description: Ensure continuous software package vulnerability assessment is active on all virtual machine compute instances.

title: Automated Malware and Ransomware Detection for Storage Buckets
description: Scan incoming object storage uploads for malware signatures, trojans, and ransomware artifacts.

title: Centralized Security Hub and Posture Aggregation Configured
description: Aggregate security findings across regions and member accounts into a primary security orchestrator.

title: Restrict Cryptographic Key Policy Wildcard Access (*)
description: Prohibit unrestricted principal asterisks in cryptographic key policies to prevent cross-tenant key usage.

title: Ensure No Unencrypted Plaintext Secrets in Environment Variables
description: Store database credentials, API tokens, and private keys in secret vaults instead of function environment variables.

title: Mandatory Cost Allocation and Ownership Resource Tags Enforced
description: Enforce standard resource tagging schema (Owner, Environment, Application) via cloud organization policies.

title: Centralized Automated Backup Policy Configured for All Production Resources
description: Enforce unified cross-service daily backup plans across virtual disks, databases, and file systems.

title: Infrastructure as Code Drift Detection and Versioning Active
description: Detect out-of-band manual cloud resource modifications and enforce automated IaC delivery pipelines.

title: Adopt Modern General-Purpose Storage Volume Types (gp3 / Premium SSD)
description: Migrate legacy gp2/standard storage volumes to modern gp3 and Premium SSD v2 for baseline IOPS decoupling.

title: Auto-Scaling Groups Spanning Multiple Availability Zones for Balanced Load
description: Distribute compute capacity across three or more availability zones to prevent hotspot performance degradation.

title: Storage Lifecycle Transition to Energy-Efficient Cold Archive Tiers
description: Transition cold compliance storage to tape-equivalent deep archive tiers reducing data center power consumption.

title: Identify and Downsize Low-CPU Idle Compute Instances
description: Detect virtual machine instances with peak CPU utilization under 5% over 14 days and downsize or terminate.

title: Data Warehouse Cluster Encryption at Rest with KMS
description: Ensure cloud data warehouse clusters enforce server-side encryption with customer-managed keys.

title: Prohibit Public Ingress to Data Warehouse Clusters
description: Ensure data warehouse clusters and analytics datasets are not publicly accessible from the internet.

title: Enable Audit and User Query Logging on Analytics Clusters
description: Stream connection user authentication and query execution logs to central audit repositories.

title: Big Data Analytics Clusters Enforce In-Transit and At-Rest Encryption
description: Ensure managed big data clusters enforce node-to-node TLS encryption and persistent disk encryption.

title: Message Queues Encrypted at Rest with KMS Keys
description: Ensure message queues enforce server-side encryption protecting payload data from unauthorized access.

title: Notification Topics Encrypted and Restrict Cross-Account Publishing
description: Prohibit unrestricted wildcard principals in topic access policies and enforce KMS encryption.

title: Real-Time Event Streams Enforce Server-Side KMS Encryption
description: Encrypt real-time streaming ingestion pipelines using customer-managed cryptographic keys.

title: Dead-Letter Queues (DLQ) Attached to Asynchronous Event Consumers
description: Ensure failed message deliveries are redirected to dead-letter queues avoiding silent data drops.

title: Machine Learning Training Datasets & Storage Encrypted with KMS CMK
description: Ensure ML training data volumes, model artifacts, and evaluation sets use customer-managed encryption.

title: AI Model Inference Endpoints Deployed Inside Isolated VPC Subnets
description: Prohibit public unauthenticated access to machine learning inference endpoints and API interfaces.

title: AI Development Notebook Instances Disallow Direct Internet Access
description: Ensure machine learning development workspaces route traffic strictly through inspected VPC gateways.

title: OpenSearch Clusters Enforce Node-to-Node and At-Rest Encryption
description: Enforce internal cluster TLS node-to-node encryption and persistent volume KMS encryption.

title: OpenSearch Domains Deployed Inside Private VPC Subnets
description: Ensure enterprise search domains are not assigned public endpoints and remain inside customer VPCs.

title: OpenSearch Audit and Error Logs Streamed to CloudWatch
description: Enable and publish search cluster audit, slow query, and error logs for compliance forensic analysis.

title: SSL/TLS Certificate Expiration Monitored Within 30 Days
description: Ensure managed public/private certificates are automatically renewed or flagged 30 days prior to expiry.

title: Managed SSL/TLS Certificates Use Strong Cryptographic Algorithms
description: Verify active certificates employ modern RSA (≥2048-bit) or ECDSA algorithms; prohibit deprecated SHA-1.

title: Content Delivery Distribution Uses Origin Access Control (OAC)
description: Ensure CDN distributions restrict origin S3/Blob access exclusively to CDN identity, bypassing direct bucket URLs.

title: Enforce HTTPS Redirect on Edge Content Delivery Networks
description: Automatically redirect unencrypted HTTP viewer requests to HTTPS on all edge distribution behaviors.

title: Web Application Firewall Rate Limiting Rules Active
description: Associate IP rate-based rules on edge WAF ACLs protecting against HTTP flood DDoS and brute force.

title: CI/CD Build Projects Mask Sensitive Environment Variables
description: Ensure pipeline build definitions reference secret stores and do not expose unmasked API keys in build specs.

title: Source Code Repositories Enforce Branch Protection & Signed Commits
description: Require code reviews, continuous integration status checks, and GPG signed commits before merge.

title: Restrict Unrestricted Cross-VPC Peering Connection Routes
description: Ensure VPC peering connections do not allow full subnet routing (0.0.0.0/0) across unrelated environments.

title: Cloud Network Firewall Active for Centralized Egress Filtering
description: Deploy stateful cloud network firewall inspecting outbound internet egress for botnet C2 communication.

title: Centralized Identity Federation (SSO) Enforced for Multi-Account Access
description: Enforce SAML 2.0 / OIDC identity federation for administrative console access rather than local IAM users.

title: Auto-Scaling Groups Use Application-Level Elastic Health Checks
description: Configure load balancer HTTP target health checks rather than basic hypervisor EC2 ping checks.
